title: THE NATIONAL AUDITION | The Harsh Reality They Never Tell You #shorts
hook: People do not actually hate corruption. They just hate that it is not their turn yet.
description:
People do not actually hate corruption. They just hate that it is not their turn yet.

People do not actually hate corruption. They just hate that it is not their turn yet. If a destitute man steals a loaf in the alley, an angry mob hunts him down without mercy. But when an oligarch embezzles eighty billion from the treasury, his community greets him with chieftaincy titles. The problem is rarely the leadership alone; it is the culture of survival. The loud activist shouts from the barricades, until they are granted an air-conditioned office and a seat at the banquet. The secret dream was never to dismantle the citadel. The secret dream was always to survive long enough to hold the golden ladle. Until a people hate the crime more than they envy the criminal, the cycle will repeat forever.
